description: This PHP class, BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber, subscribes to specific customer events (employee deletion and purge completion) within the OrangeHRM system, and adjusts like and comment counts related to Buzz shares and comments accordingly.

classes.name: BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to employee-related events (purge and delete) to adjust the like and comment counts on Buzz shares and comments within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and the corresponding handler methods to which this class subscribes.

methods.name: onEmployeePurgingEnd
methods.description: Handles the event fired at the end of an employee purge, updating Buzz share and comment counts accordingly.

methods.name: onEmployeesDeleted
methods.description: Handles the event fired when employees are deleted, updating Buzz share and comment counts accordingly.
